content_sections.heading: NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NTPC has advertised a total of 135 Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) posts across three engineering disciplines. The projected vacancies indicated may increase or decrease as per organisational requirement, at the discretion of NTPC Management. The vacancies indicated include backlog vacancies. *As per the official notification, the SC/ST figures marked with an asterisk include backlog vacancies. Reservation for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) candidates will be as per Government guidelines, within the identified disability categories listed for each discipline below. These disability category abbreviations are reproduced exactly as listed in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution. Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering/Energy Efficiency/Project Management/Field Quality, or a combination thereof, in the relevant discipline. Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Mechanical/Production with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution. Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering/Energy Efficiency/Project Management/Field Quality, or a combination thereof, in the relevant discipline. Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Electronics/Control & Instrumentation/Instrumentation with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution. Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering/Energy Efficiency/Project Management/Field Quality, or a combination thereof, in the relevant discipline. Out of the 10 years of post-qualification executive experience mentioned above (including training/trainee period, if any) in the executive cadre, candidates currently working in a Govt/Public Sector Undertaking should have a minimum of 2 years of experience in the pay scale of Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 or above (IDA pay scale of E-3 Grade or above of NTPC, effective from 01.01.2017) or an equivalent scale. Such candidates must also provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer while applying for the post. In terms of educational qualification, only pass marks are required for SC/ST/PwBD candidates to apply (i.e., the 60% marks criterion does not apply to these categories). The total years of experience required will be relaxed by 2 years for SC/ST candidates. Before joining, candidates will have to undergo a medical examination by the NTPC Medical Board/Officer, and their decision will be final and binding. No relaxation in prescribed health standards is allowed. Detailed medical norms are available on the website careers.ntpc.co.in; all applicants are advised to review these norms before applying.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale
content_sections.text: All three posts - Deputy Manager (Electrical), Deputy Manager (Mechanical), and Deputy Manager (C&I) - are at the E-4 Grade level, carrying the IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000 – 2,00,000 per month (w.e.f. 01.01.2017). The notification does not specify additional allowances or gross salary figures beyond this pay scale.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: In order to restrict the number of candidates for the selection process, if required, NTPC Management reserves the right to conduct a multi-stage selection process, which may comprise: Application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification, percentage of marks, number of years of post-qualification experience, etc.) Written/Computer-Based Test Personal Interview Or a combination of the above

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload all required documents while applying; applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected or not considered for further process. Class X passing certificate/Mark sheet and PAN Card, for proof of Name and Date of Birth (Name and DOB should appear in conformity on all documents). B.E./B.Tech Degree (Final/Provisional) certificate. Engineering consolidated Mark sheet/Transcript, or all-semester mark sheets clearly indicating aggregate percentage of marks in all semesters. Marks conversion formula from the university/institute, for conversion of CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into a percentage. Caste/Disability certificate (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates), as applicable. OBC-NCL certificate in the central format, for the current financial year (FY 2026-27). Current-year Income & Asset certificate for EWS candidates, valid for FY 2026-27 based on FY 2025-26 income. Disability certificate as per the latest prescribed Central Government format, generated online through the Swalamban/UDID portal, clearly indicating the type and percentage of disability in line with the identified disability categories for the post. All experience-related documents for each organisation/company, placed together in chronological order from the first to the last/current company, which may include: Experience/Service Certificate (as per NTPC's prescribed sample format); Offer of Appointment/Appointment Letter/Offer Letter with Confirmation/Absorption Letter/Order on Completion of Training (if any); Joining Order/Letter; Role Assignment orders; Promotion orders; Transfer orders; Organization charts; Form-16; and two pay slips for every year for each organisation, to corroborate the work area/department/section. NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the current employer, for candidates currently working in Govt/Public Sector Undertakings. Pay-scale circular/matrix, for candidates currently working in Govt/PSUs, to verify a minimum of 2 years' service in the required pay scale of Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 or above (IDA pay scale of E-3 Grade or above of NTPC, effective from 01.01.2017) or equivalent scale.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only in online mode, through NTPC's careers website. No other mode of application will be accepted. Log on to careers.ntpc.co.in, or visit the careers section at www.ntpc.co.in. Register with a valid, active email ID (NTPC will not be responsible for bounced emails sent to candidates). Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details for the discipline being applied for. Upload all required documents as listed in the Documents Required section above. Pay the applicable application fee (General/EWS/OBC candidates only), either offline via the SBI pay-in-slip process, or online through Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card. After applying online, download the system-generated application slip bearing a unique application number, and retain a copy for future reference. No documents need to be sent by post.

faq.question: Q1. What is NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. 10/26 issued by NTPC Limited inviting applications from experienced professionals for 135 Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) posts across Electrical, Mechanical, and C&I disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 135 posts are available: 40 in Electrical, 55 in Mechanical, and 40 in C&I. NTPC notes that these projected vacancies may increase or decrease at the discretion of Management.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window is open from 12 August 2026 to 26 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NTPC Deputy Manager posts?
faq.answer: A full-time B.E./B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline – Electrical/Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical/Production, or Electronics/Control & Instrumentation/Instrumentation – with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution. For SC/ST/PwBD candidates, only pass marks are required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for all three posts, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, and 10 years for PwBD candidates, and relaxation for Ex-Servicemen as per Government guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General, EWS, and OBC category candidates must pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/-. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, and female candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only, through careers.ntpc.co.in or the careers section of www.ntpc.co.in. There is no offline mode of application, and no documents need to be sent by post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection may involve application shortlisting/screening, followed by a Written/Computer-Based Test and/or Personal Interview, or a combination of these stages, as decided by NTPC Management.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay scale for NTPC Deputy Manager posts?
faq.answer: All three posts are at E-4 Grade, carrying an IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 per month (w.e.f. 01.01.2017).

faq.question: Q10. What is the minimum experience required for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A minimum of 10 years of post-qualification executive experience in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in the relevant discipline is required for all three posts, with a 2-year relaxation in required experience for SC/ST candidates.
